subhead: The Ukrainian emergency services said the attack had also wounded 130 people, 23 of them children. The strikes on President Volodymyr Zelensky's hometown come as Russia has intensified its bombardment of Ukrainian cities in recent months.

subhead: Bellina's body was found partially burned near the southern city of Nîmes on August 12. A 32-year-old suspect, who was already known to authorities for domestic violence, was placed in preventive detention on Friday.

title: 'My way of fighting is by giving women work': Afghan women turn to entrepreneurship
subhead: 'Voices of Afghan Women' (6/6). Paradoxically, one of the few rights women still have is the opportunity to start a business. Many have learned the basics through online courses and promote their work on social media. But how much longer will that remain possible?

title: Julian Alaphilippe, two-time world champion and iconic figure of French cycling, announces retirement
subhead: The cyclist revealed his decision to retire at the age of 34, after more than a decade in the professional peloton. With 45 victories throughout his career, including six Tour de France stage wins and a Milan-San Remo title, he has left an indelible mark on the sport's history.

title: As Israel elections approach, public debates and campaign plaforms avoid discussing end of war
subhead: With general elections planned in October, opinion polls paint a picture of a society losing hope for its future and seeing no alternative to the use of force. Candidates are taking care to appear as credible as Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on security issues.

Why Le Pen's plan for a constitutional referendum would be 'a coup d'état in form and content'
subhead: If she were to win, far-right presidential candidate Marine Le Pen has pledged to call a referendum to revise the Constitution and enshrine the far right's core principles in it. According to a member of the highest administrative court, this would be 'a double coup d'état, both in form and content.'

title: Mont Blanc massif destablilized by summer heatwaves and rockfalls
subhead: As a result of extreme temperatures, which have weakened both its ice and its rock faces, the highest peak in the Alps is currently inaccessible by any of its three standard climbing routes.

title: Kyiv's brief glimmers of joy amidst war: 'Never in my life have I seen so many beautiful people in one place'
subhead: For the second year in a row, the Vyriy music and visual arts festival brought together several thousand people in Kyiv on August 8 and 9, despite relentless Russian drone attacks. Soldiers on leave and families joined partygoers to dance and celebrate Ukrainian folklore inside this rare bubble of peace.
